summary: Tested new university_president read-only role. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests passed covering login payload/permissions, 10 read endpoints, dashboard scope (كل الجامعة, students=91, finance ok), PDF/Excel export with X-Filename, all 7 write endpoints blocked with exact Arabic 403 message, admin never gets read-only 403, guard whitelist (notifications read-all, change-password wrong pwd -> 400, renewal-status, record-view), admin sanity, dean scope (كلية الشريعة والقانون, 19), teacher dashboard 403.
